title: Nodal DGFT Regional Authority
text: 3.07 Nodal DGFT Regional Authority Districts of the States/UTs have been assigned to the Jurisdictional DGFT Regional Authority and the nodal RA shall be responsible for the Districts under their jurisdiction for all activities related to Districts as Export Hubs initiative in those Districts. Appendix 1A has the list of DGFT Regional Authorities with their District and State wise Jurisdiction.
